reports.title: Happen, Inc. Reports Third Quarter 2026 Results

guidance.heading: Financial Outlook
section: •Narrowing full year 2026 originations guidance, prioritizing unit margins in the elevated rate environment while driving 26%-27% annual growth.
•Raising full year 2026 diluted EPS guidance to $1.87-$1.92 from $1.80-$1.90, reflecting 61%-66% annual growth.
•Guidance assumes a stable consumer and interest rate environment, with a 25 basis point increase in the Fed funds rate in December.
